newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITIMPEKS TO ANNOUNCE 1Q RESULTS NEXT WEEK.
newsitem.headline: LITIMPEKS TO ANNOUNCE 1Q RESULTS NEXT WEEK.

text.p: Lithuania's Litimpeks Bank said on Monday that it plans to reveal its first quarter results in a week.
"We plan to announce our first quarter results next week," Edmundas Kachkus, a member of the bank's board, told Reuters.
"The results are what we expected," he added but declined to mention exact figures.
The bank said earlier that it was looking for a strategic investor and that six foreign and local investors were showing an interest.
"Our bank continues to negotiate with potential strategic and portfolio investors," Kachkus said.
"At the present moment an intensive exchange of information is going on," he added.
Estonia's Hoiupank, which earlier had expressed interest in investing in Litimpeks, said last week that it was no longer interested in the bank.
Litimpeks was reopened last summer after being shut by the central bank at the end of 1995.
